name: Why are roof valleys so important for roof integrity?

mainEntity.name: Why are roof valleys so important for roof integrity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roof valleys are crucial because they channel large volumes of rainwater and snowmelt from two converging roof sections into the gutter system. As such, they are high-stress areas that experience greater water flow and potential debris accumulation compared to flat roof sections. If a valley is compromised, even a small defect can lead to significant water penetration, potentially causing damage to the roof decking, attic, and interior of your home. Proper valley integrity is vital for preventing water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Valleys channel large volumes of water, making them high-stress areas where defects can cause significant leaks and water damage to the home.
